notes: The receive and transmit FIFO instances are another IP, so paths from their inputs to their driven status outputs use the required black-box assumption where applicable.

C3 and C4 describe retained FIFO metadata, but their internal route_src and rx_last registers are copies of non-record input-port values; because those concepts list integrity but not confidentiality, the copies are not direction-a secondaries under the stated rules.
The bus response record is used for read-back of several concepts, but record response ports and mixed register read-back words are not primary boundary assets under the stated rules.
